i: WHAT IT IS: your MV phrase is a VERSE - a song line, a poem or your own sentence of at least 7 words. Verso never asks for the whole verse - each time 2 random words (e.g. word 1 + word 4).
HOW TO ANSWER: write both words TOGETHER, without a space, in the order asked - „pekný deň“ → peknyden. Accents and capitals do not matter.

DECOY SYMBOLS: mix in any of @ # / $ & * ! ? ; : , . " ( ) anywhere - $p#e/k&!ny*d;e?:n counts as peknyden. A watcher or a screen recording sees noise; Verso keeps only letters and digits. (Against a hidden program that reads every key it does not help - that is why there are 2 random words and the 5-try lock.)

WHAT IT GUARDS: Advanced setup + MODES (one verification = 10 min) · EVERY TIME anew: FINAL, adding / removing a verse, LOG OUT on MY DEVICE, emptying the trash · RECOVERY (token from e-mail + verse - the only way). 5 wrong = 15 min lock + e-mail to you. Every check is in MV LOG and AUDIT LOG.

+ ADD VERSE: verify first, then write the whole verse (min. 7 words, max. 40, up to 10 verses). Verso asks from a random one of them. Adding or removing sends you an e-mail. × REMOVE: the last verse stays (one factor always remains).
BASE MV PHRASE: older accounts keep their base phrase - used while you have no verse (and for LOG OUT / FINAL for now). New accounts write their first verse at registration.

⭐ RECOMMENDED: protect the e-mail of your Verso account with its own code (2-step verification at your mail provider). The recovery token comes there - until the next ways arrive (hybrid server, watch, automated phone call), e-mail + verse are your way back in. Never write the verse down anywhere.

SET UP ONCE: 1) VIEW / CHANGE COMMANDS · MV PHRASE → write your MV PHRASE → OPEN. 2) Write the PRIVATE command and the REMOTE command (3-40 characters, not the same). Verso keeps only their fingerprint (hash): they are never shown again, only replaced - remember them. Empty field = keep, - = remove. 3) PREVIEW AS (optional): usernames whose view you want to try. 4) SAVE within 15 s - after 15 s the fields close and nothing is kept on screen.
HOW TO HOLD: computer = hold Ctrl + the letter 3 s · Verso keyboard = hold Ctrl and hold the letter 3 s. Then a 10 s window asks for the command. The same command again = switch off.

🔒 PRIVATE · Ctrl + S + PRIVATE command: what you write now is PRIVATE - records (ENTER), their chats, VI chats, notes, notifications, media and READ SPACE pages; hidden in the normal mode, shown in PRIVATE. Everything Verso reads goes via IP SHIELD. Red 🔒 in the web line while on. End: Ctrl + S again or tap the red 🔒. Verso opens again on every switch.

📡 REMOTE ACCESS (you are the OWNER): 1) share records below (REMOTE ACCESS · MY SHARES). 2) Ctrl + R + REMOTE command = OPEN (📡 in the web line). 3) Ctrl + R again = CLOSED for everybody, shares stay for next time.

🔗 ACCESS (you are the GUEST, on your own device): Ctrl + A + YOUR REMOTE command = the records shared with you load READ ONLY - with READ + WRITE you may also write in their chat / notes under your own name (🔗 in the web line). The owner must have REMOTE ACCESS open. Ctrl + A again = deactivate.

● LIVE: Ctrl + L = choose ONE session from what is open / activated. The MODERATOR (owner first) leads - what he opens, the others see. MOD → = hand over · LEAVE = out. Only record numbers travel, never the screen; everybody writes in chat under his own name.
👁 PREVIEW AS: see Verso on THIS device as the PREVIEW AS users would (read only). Tap the button or the 👁 in the web line again = end.

LOG + AUDIT LOG: every step (PRIVATE on / off, open, close, activate, join, leave, moderator, share, stop, wrong command, MV check) is in LOG here and in AUDIT LOG - for you, the owner and the guest. The commands and the phrase are never written anywhere.
SAFETY: 5 wrong commands = 15 min lock. MV PHRASE is the same as for LOG OUT / FINAL (5 wrong = 15 min). READ only for now - nobody can change your records.

STEP BY STEP: 1) write the guest username. 2) write the record number (EN). 3) READ or READ + WRITE (tap to switch). 4) + SHARE - Verso checks the guest may already see this record (USER / consent / COMM SETUP); if not, it refuses and says why. 4) open access: hold Ctrl + R 3 s + REMOTE command.
The status line says OPEN 📡 or CLOSED and how many shares. Each line = guest · # record · title · READ / WRITE. → + WRITE / → READ switches the rights · × STOP = the share ends at once (all logged).
READ + WRITE = the guest may write in the chat / notes of that record under his own name; the record itself is changed only by the owner (EDIT = new version).
MV PHRASE: adding a share or giving WRITE asks once for it - then 10 min free. Taking access away (× STOP, → READ) never needs it.
A share alone does nothing while REMOTE ACCESS is CLOSED. Closing never deletes the shares.
Records other owners shared with you - shown only while their REMOTE ACCESS is OPEN.

Activate: hold Ctrl + A 3 s + YOUR REMOTE command → 🔗 in the web line, the records open READ ONLY under your own login (READ + WRITE shares: also chat / notes under your name). Ctrl + A again = deactivate. Then Ctrl + L = LIVE with the owner.
Choose one session = one shared record. The MODERATOR leads: the records he opens open for everybody (only those you may see).
The LIVE bar: # record · MOD name · number of people. MOD → (moderator only) = hand over the moderation · LEAVE = leave the session. Ctrl + L = this list again.
Nothing of your screen travels - only record numbers. Every join / leave / hand-over is in LOG and AUDIT LOG.

MAIN SWITCH: IP SHIELD (default) = the Verso server reads the pages for you - the site sees the Verso server, not your IP. AUTO / PHONE (DIRECT) = your phone reads them itself (the site sees your IP).
PRIVATE mode puts everything on IP SHIELD whatever is set here. READ SPACE › ⚙ READ SETUP › PAGES can keep its own choice (BY SETTINGS = this switch).
Tap an interest: 1× = MINE (gold, used only inside Verso) · 2× = SHARE OK (green, may be shared later with your consent) · 3× = off.
Own interest: write it → + ADD. WHEN SHARED: NO ID (default, the other side gets only totals from 10 people up) · RANDOM ID PER APP · MY USERNAME.

OFFERS FOR YOU (NO ID): Verso itself compares the offers of the apps you connected with your card (MINE + SHARE OK) and shows them only to you, here. The app never learns who saw what - it only gets totals of views per interest (SHARE OK only, from 10 people up).

MY APPS · OWNER: only if you own an app connected through VERSO GATE - its totals (consents, interests, offer views; groups under 10 are never shown) and EDIT OFFERS (one per line: title | https://link | tag, tag). Saving replaces the whole list.

An app reads the SHARE OK interests only after you allow „interests“ on its VERSO GATE consent screen. The list below shows those apps - × DISCONNECT withdraws it at once. Every reading is in AUDIT LOG.
The list of everything waiting: chat messages, REMS, SCHEDS, DISCUSS, system and ISSUES lines - coloured by priority (red urgent, orange attention, green open).
2× tap on the list = full screen and back; in full screen also ✕ and „✓ ISSUES n“ = all issue lines READ on this device (they stay in your ISSUES record, UNDO a few seconds).
Tap a row = open it (chat on that message; an issue line opens in the READER alone). Swipe a row = READ / SHIFTED / ⏰ ALARM.
The coloured numbers on top = counts per kind - tap = jump to the first one. 📖 = all items as one READER page. ⤢ = NOTIFICATIONS workspace.
All notifications by kind and time; the shift bar moves items to later (with ⏰ ALARM); 📖 READER in the title.

Your chats in one place: ATTACHED CHATS on top, the COMM FEEDER = the newest messages. Chats show the newest messages by LIMIT (25 · 100 · ALL, chips on top: gold = set here, silver = set by SETTINGS / MINIMAL) - ▲ OLDER (hold = all).
A chat of one record: chat line at the bottom (ENTER sends), ⏰ = ALARM for a message, the translator button (hold = MULTI-LANGUAGE for this chat), ▲ OLDER = earlier messages.

All Verso settings by tab; „saved on this device: <model>“ = only this phone. ⚡ MINIMAL MODE (first box) = lighter start, only by hand. ℹ INFO = SYSTEM CHECK, 5S SUPPORT and other informative switches.
Every medium is one line; READ stays forever. Tap ▶ = VERSO READER / player, hold 1-2 s = the original. PRIVATE tab is hidden in QUIET.
Content as a Verso page: SHOW bar on top (LIMIT · FILTER · HIDE · PRESET · RESET), SWIPE bar at the bottom; select text → NOTE / DESCRIPTION / COPY; × closes.
Verso apps and modules: one row per app; APK UPDATE / WEB UPDATE show the version in green when it is the newest.
Nothing is deleted for good - rows here can be brought back.
Your records (EL / CL) in the CRM grid: tap a cell to open, SELECT for many rows, 📖 READER in the title.

versoMoveButton: Tap = MOVE armed (gold) → tap the destination tab in TEMPLATES = the TAG where the new record goes. Tap MOVE again = cancel.
versoBackButton: ← UNDO the last change in the CL / fields. Hold 3 s = undo everything back.
versoForwardButton: → REDO what UNDO took back. Hold 3 s = redo everything.
versoCopyButton: Copy the field you are in (or the selected text / cells) to the VERSO CLIPBOARD. Then tap the target field and PASTE.
versoDeleteButton: Tap = delete the selected CL cells · hold 3 s = reset the whole CL · hold 5 s = selected records to TRASH (nothing is deleted for good - TRASH can bring it back). Vibration marks 3 s and 5 s.
versoSettingsButton: Opens SETTINGS: Login setup (password, MV PHRASE), Setup (device, LIMIT, ℹ INFO, 5S SUPPORT), Advanced setup (MODES, VERSO GATE…), Multi Verification, Restore, Archive.
versoEditButton: EDIT: select a record / cells first, then hold 3 s = edit them in the CL. Shows PASTE when the VERSO CLIPBOARD has something.
versoAutomateButton: SELECT mode on / off (gold = on): tap rows or cells to select them. Hold 3 s = SELECT ALL in the open list (again = none).
versoEntryButton: VERSO logo = FIX (saved states of the CL): tap = next FIX · hold 3 s = new EXTRA FIX · 5 s = back to the MAIN FIX · 10 s = save the MAIN FIX · 20 s = clear all FIX. Vibration marks each step.
versoSystemEntryButton: ENTER = write the CL as a new record (Verso gives it the ENTRY NUMBER). With a MOVE target, drafts or selected rows it asks you to HOLD 3 s; hold 3 s with selected rows = PLACEMENT window (where they go).
versoSearchButton: SEARCH mode on / off: the CL cells become FILTERS - write into a column and the lists show only matching records. Off = filters cleared.
versoAIButton: +AI+ = Verso VI: tap = VI / the hidden NOTIF LINE back · hold 1-2 s = QUIET / SAFETY REGIME on / off · hold ~5 s = check for a Verso update.
versoOperateButton: OPERATE - reserved, the function comes later.
versoWebButton: WEB - reserved for the VERSO BROWSER (now use the web line under the tabs).
versoSmartButton: SMART - reserved, the function comes later.
versoRecordButton: RECORD - reserved, the function comes later.
versoReadAutomateButton: AUTOMATE - reserved, the function comes later.
versoTechnologyButton: TECHNOL - reserved, the function comes later.
zzzWlInput: WEB LINE: paste or write a web link + Enter = the page goes into READ SPACE › TEMP and opens in the VERSO READER (via IP SHIELD by default).
zzzWlEye: 👁 WATCH the link in the web line (or the page open in READ SPACE): Verso checks it and tells you when it changes.
zzzWlPriv: Mode chips (red = on): 🔒 PRIVATE · 📡 REMOTE ACCESS open · 🔗 ACCESS active · 👁 PREVIEW AS · ● LIVE. Tap = end PRIVATE / PREVIEW AS.

PRESET: Opens PRESET: saved line templates - tap one to fill the CL.
PROJECTS: Your projects (records with a PROJECT NUMBER).
PRIVATE: Records marked PRIVATE (PRIVACY dot filled) - only you see them.
TRASH: TRASH: nothing is deleted for good - every row can be brought back (RESTORE).
ORG: ORGANIZER - records ordered by your organisation / tags.
ARCHIVE: ARCHIVE: finished records out of the way, still readable and restorable.
NOTIFICATIONS: All notifications by kind and time; the shift bar moves them later (⏰ ALARM).
READ: READ SPACE: web pages you saved - collections, KEEP, 👁 WATCH, TRASH; ⚙ READ SETUP.
TEMPLATES: TEMPLATES: tabs and their TAGs - MOVE uses them as the destination of a new record.
APPS: Verso apps and modules, APK UPDATE / WEB UPDATE (green = newest).
COMMUNICATION: COMM SPACE: your chats, COMM FEEDER = newest messages.
DATABASE: DATABASE: all records you may see, in the CRM grid. SEARCH mode filters it.
AUTHOR CREDITS: AUTHOR CREDITS - who made / owns what (authorship records).
MINI: MINI / PRESET of the CL line - quick presets of this line.
ENTRY NUMBER: ENTRY NUMBER (EN) - the number Verso gives every record when ENTER writes it.
PROJECT NUMBER: PROJECT NUMBER - the project the record belongs to.
PROJECT NAME: PROJECT NAME - the title of the record / project.
PROJECT OWNER: PROJECT OWNER - who owns the record (username).
PROJECT CATEGORY: PROJECT CATEGORY - the kind of record.
SUBS: SUBS - sub-records / sub-categories; also the placement target for MOVE.
PRIVACY: PRIVACY dot: filled = PRIVATE (only you), empty = public by your COMM SETUP rules.
CONTENT: CONTENT - the main text of the record.
PRIORITY: PRIORITY - red urgent, orange attention, green open.
LINK: LINK - a web link or a link to another record.
USER: USER - the users the record is for (their consent decides what they see).
COMMUNICATION: COMMUNICATION - the chat / group of the record.
TAG: TAG - where the record belongs (tab / template).
ALARM: ALARM - date and time Verso reminds you.
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT - read-only history: who changed / pasted what and when.
Advanced setup: Advanced setup: MODES (PRIVATE, REMOTE ACCESS, LIVE), VERSO GATE, module setups.
Multi Verification: Multi Verification: confirmations that need the MV PHRASE / more devices.
Restore: Restore: bring back records / settings saved before.
Setup: Setup: this device - ⚡ MINIMAL MODE, LIMIT, language, ℹ INFO (SYSTEM CHECK, 5S SUPPORT).
Login setup: Login setup: CHANGE PASSWORD and MV PHRASE (current password needed).
LOG OUT: LOG OUT of Verso on this device (MV PHRASE asked when set).
SAVE MV PHRASE: Saves the MV PHRASE (min. 4 letters) - write CURRENT PASSWORD first. It can never be shown again - keep it safe.
CHANGE PASSWORD: CURRENT PASSWORD → NEW PASSWORD → CONFIRM NEW PASSWORD → save.
WEB UPDATE (Verso web version): Loads the newest Verso web version (the date must match on all your devices).
APK UPDATE (Verso app): Downloads the newest Android Verso app.
SELECT: SELECT mode - tap rows / cells to select.
PASTE: PASTE the VERSO CLIPBOARD into the field you tapped (recorded in ACKNOWLEDGEMENT).
DELETE: Delete - nothing is lost for good, TRASH keeps it.
UNDO: UNDO - takes the last step back (a few seconds).
RESTORE: RESTORE - bring the row back from TRASH / ARCHIVE.
CLOSE: Close this window - nothing is lost.
SHOW: SHOW bar: LIMIT · FILTER · HIDE · PRESET · RESET for this list / page.
CLEAR FILTER: Remove the filter - the full list again.
LIMIT: LIMIT how many lines show (25 · 100 · ALL); ▲ OLDER = more.
HIDE: HIDE lines you do not need (they stay saved).
CONSENT: CONSENT - what a user agreed to share / see; it decides every share.
PRE-APPROVE: PRE-APPROVE - give consent in advance for this kind of request.
WITHDRAW: WITHDRAW your consent - from now on it no longer applies (logged).
CONTACTS: CONTACTS - your people and groups; hold = CONSENT window.
COMM SETUP: COMM SETUP - who may see / write what (rules used everywhere, also REMOTE ACCESS).
TASKS: TASKS - your tasks; TASK DONE / ⇄ GIVE TO / ↻ RE-ISSUE.
⇄ GIVE TO: Hand the task to another user.
SAVE AS PRESET: Save the current CL / filter as a PRESET.
SAVE NOTE: Save the note to the chosen record.
CHATNOTE: CHATNOTE - a note inside the chat.
SHARE: SHARE - send to a user / chat (by consent).
ENTER TO SUBS: Write the CL as a SUB of the target record.
READ SETUP: ⚙ READ SETUP: where pages are stored, KEEP, cache, images, PAGES (IP SHIELD / app), clip, WATCH, TRASH.
+ BUNDLE: New bundle (folder) of collections in READ SPACE.
↗ ORIGINAL: Open the original web page (outside Verso).
👁 CHECK: Check the page now for changes (WATCH).
DISS: DISS - pages / lines you dismissed (still kept, can come back).
KEPT: KEPT - versions you KEPT of this page (newest wins).
VI: VI - Verso intelligence for this item.
VI SPACE: VI SPACE - VI chats and packs.
PACKS: PACKS - groups of VI / task items.
DASHBOARD: DASHBOARD - everything waiting, by priority colour.
MEDIA SPACE: MEDIA - every medium one line; ▶ = VERSO READER / player.
REGISTER: Create a Verso account (activation code needed).
SEND TOKEN: EMERGENCY RECOVERY: a token comes to your e-mail.
USE TOKEN: Use the token from the e-mail: fill USERNAME, TOKEN and NEW PASSWORD → USE TOKEN → Verso asks for 2 words of your verse (together, no space). Right = new password, every device logged out, a new token in your e-mail.
REFRESH: Load again from the Verso server.
VERSO GATE: VERSO GATE - how outside apps / services may reach your data (with consent).
⚡ MINIMAL MODE: MINIMAL MODE - lighter start on this device (no auto readers, LIMIT 25).
5S SUPPORT: 5S SUPPORT on / off on this device: hold anything 5 s = its instructions.

bars.i: Work with the CL (the line for a new record) and selections: ← UNDO · → REDO · MOVE (destination TAG) · COPY / PASTE (VERSO CLIPBOARD) · SELECT (hold = all) · EDIT (hold 3 s) · DELETE (tap / 3 s / 5 s) · SETTINGS. The VERSO logo in the middle = FIX states of the CL. Usual flow: fill the CL → (MOVE) → ENTER on the right.

ENTER writes the CL as a record · SEARCH turns the CL into filters · +AI+ in the middle = VI, QUIET (hold) and update (long hold). OPERATE, WEB, TECHNOL, SMART, RECORD, AUTOMATE are reserved for later modules.

Each tab opens a workspace: PRESET · PROJECTS · PRIVATE · FAVORITES · TRASH · ORG · ARCHIVE · NOTIFICATIONS · READ (READ SPACE) · TEMPLATES · APPS · COMMUNICATION · DATABASE · AUTHOR CREDITS. Tap again = close. Swipe the bar for more.
The first step of the VERSO BROWSER: link + Enter = READ SPACE › TEMP + VERSO READER. 👁 = WATCH · × = clear · red chips on the left = modes on (🔒 PRIVATE, 📡 REMOTE, 🔗 ACCESS, ● LIVE).
The names of the columns of a record. The CL line under them is where you write a new record (or filters in SEARCH mode). PRIVACY dot filled = PRIVATE.
Write a new record here column by column, then ENTER. In SEARCH mode the same cells filter the lists. COPY / PASTE / DELETE / ← → work on these cells.
Login setup (password, MV PHRASE) · Setup (this device) · Advanced setup (MODES, VERSO GATE) · Multi Verification · Restore · Archive. Hold any setting 5 s = its own instructions.
LIMIT how many lines · FILTER · HIDE · PRESET (saved view) · RESET (default).
TASK DONE = finished · ⇄ GIVE TO = hand over · ↻ RE-ISSUE = again (tap twice).
Consents decide what others may see / get. PRE-APPROVE = in advance · WITHDRAW = stop it. Everything is logged.
